module.purpose: Provides NestJS error translation for booking-related failures in the dated enterprise bookings API service.
module.summary: This injectable service centralizes construction of HTTP exceptions for missing event types and booking failures. It selects contextual not-found messages from booking lookup fields, maps recognized domain errors to bad-request responses, and rethrows unknown errors unchanged. The service is synchronous and exception-driven, with no persistent state beyond a constructed logger.
module.businessContext: Supports booking creation APIs by returning actionable errors when event types are missing or scheduling constraints prevent booking. Failures affect API correctness and client guidance.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking request identifies a user and event type without an organization.
moduleContractTests.then: throws NotFoundException(`Event type with slug ${body.eventTypeSlug} belonging to user ${body.username} not found.`)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the user-scoped event-type not-found message.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking request identifies a team, event type, and organization.
moduleContractTests.then: throws NotFoundException(`Event type with slug ${body.eventTypeSlug} belonging to team ${body.teamSlug} within organization ${body.organizationSlug} not found.`)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures organization-qualified team lookup failures remain distinguishable.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking request lacks a matching username or team event-type context.
moduleContractTests.then: throws NotFoundException(`Event type with id ${body.eventTypeId} not found.`)

moduleContractTests.scenario: A team booking encounters the no-available-users error.
moduleContractTests.then: throws BadRequestException("One of the hosts either already has booking at this time or is not available")
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the distinct host-availability message for team bookings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking attempt fails because its requested start time is outside the allowed booking window.
moduleContractTests.then: throws BadRequestException containing "The event type can't be booked at the \"start\" time provided."
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures invalid timing is translated into the documented client-facing error.
